## What it is

Partie haute de l'ancien `boitier_int`, bac brut. Face sud de l'aile est à y = 60 jusqu'à x = 120. Décrochage sud-ouest : face sud à y = 71 de x = 12 à x = 50, largeur du DC, pour que le DC s'emboîte. Pas d'encoche sur le mur sud. Un puits d'aimant dans la baie est.

## Design notes

Printed floor on the bed. South-west face 11 mm further north than the east wing, over DC's width (x = 12–50). East of x = 50 the south stays at `aile_y` (60). East of x = 85 the north stays at y = 85.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 0.6
```

## Don't

- Do not grow a palier/encoche south of y = 60: that tab was unused (user 2026-09-02).
- Do not enlarge DC in X to make the nest: the décrochage is AC's south-west raised 11 mm over DC's width.
- Do not restore the 10 mm gutter: the east south face runs to x = 120 at `aile_y`.
- Do not restore the seven M2 spacers or the Wago platform.
- Do not restore the rectangle AC tray (réglettes, ouverture, triangle).
- Do not fill the 10 mm gap under y_max east of x = 85: that clearance is the machine.
